mapper.select: select cast(d.id as char) document_id, s.name, s.tax_id from documents d join suppliers s on s.document_id = d.id where d.type='SUPPLIER' and d.approval_status='APPROVED' and d.deleted='0' order by s.name, d.id

select p.id,p.number,p.supplier_id,sup.name supplier_name,p.amount_cents,p.threshold_exceeded,p.status,p.current_node, p.creator_id,p.creation_key,p.revision,p.remark,p.review_comment,p.director_comment,p.create_time,p.update_time from payments p left join suppliers sup on sup.document_id=p.supplier_id where p.id=#{id} and p.deleted='0'

select pl.id,pl.payment_id,pl.invoice_id,pl.allocated_cents,i.invoice_number,i.total_cents invoice_total_cents from payment_lines pl left join invoices i on i.document_id=pl.invoice_id where pl.payment_id=#{paymentId} order by pl.id
mapper.update: update payments set supplier_id=#{supplierId},amount_cents=#{amountCents},threshold_exceeded=#{thresholdExceeded},remark=#{remark},revision=revision+1,update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{id} and revision=#{revision} and status in('DRAFT','RETURNED') and deleted='0'

update payments set amount_cents=#{amountCents},threshold_exceeded=#{thresholdExceeded}, status='IN_REVIEW',current_node='FINANCE_REVIEW',review_comment=null,director_comment=null, revision=revision+1,update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{id} and revision=#{revision} and status in('DRAFT','RETURNED') and deleted='0'
update number_sequences set next_value=next_value+1 where document_type=#{type} and business_date=#{businessDate}
mapper.select: select next_value from number_sequences where document_type=#{type} and business_date=#{businessDate}
select count(1) from documents where id=#{supplierId} and type='SUPPLIER' and approval_status='APPROVED' and deleted='0'

select coalesce(po.supplier_id,op.supplier_id) from invoices i left join purchase_orders po on po.document_id=i.order_id left join opening_payables op on op.invoice_id=i.document_id where i.document_id=#{invoiceId}
select i.total_cents from invoices i join documents d on d.id=i.document_id where d.id=#{invoiceId} and d.type='INVOICE' and d.approval_status='APPROVED' and d.deleted='0' for update

select coalesce(sum(pl.allocated_cents),0) from payment_lines pl join payments p on p.id=pl.payment_id where pl.invoice_id=#{invoiceId} and p.deleted='0' and p.status in('IN_REVIEW','READY_TO_PAY','PAID','APPROVED') and p.id<>#{excludePaymentId} for update

select count(1) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.user_id<>#{excludeId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' and r.role_key='finance'

select count(1) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.user_id<>#{excludeId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' and r.role_key='finance' and u.rank_level='EXEC'

select d.id invoice_id,i.invoice_number,i.issue_date,i.total_cents, coalesce(a.paid_cents,0) paid_cents,coalesce(a.reserved_cents,0) reserved_cents, coalesce(a.paid_cents,0)+coalesce(a.reserved_cents,0) allocated_cents, i.total_cents-coalesce(a.paid_cents,0) unpaid_cents, i.total_cents-coalesce(a.paid_cents,0)-coalesce(a.reserved_cents,0) balance_cents from invoices i join documents d on d.id=i.document_id left join purchase_orders po on po.document_id=i.order_id left join documents od on od.id=po.document_id left join opening_payables op on op.invoice_id=i.document_id left join ( select pl.invoice_id, sum(case when pp.status in('PAID','APPROVED') then pl.allocated_cents else 0 end) paid_cents, sum(case when pp.status in('IN_REVIEW','READY_TO_PAY') then pl.allocated_cents else 0 end) reserved_cents from payment_lines pl join payments pp on pp.id=pl.payment_id where pp.deleted='0' group by pl.invoice_id ) a on a.invoice_id=d.id where d.type='INVOICE' and d.approval_status='APPROVED' and d.deleted='0' and (po.document_id is not null or op.invoice_id is not null) and coalesce(po.supplier_id,op.supplier_id)=#{supplierId} and (d.creator_id=#{params.supplyScopeUserId} or od.creator_id=#{params.supplyScopeUserId} or po.buyer_id=#{params.supplyScopeUserId}) and exists(select 1 from sys_user u where u.user_id in(d.creator_id,od.creator_id,po.buyer_id) and u.dept_id=#{params.supplyScopeDeptId} and u.del_flag='0') order by i.issue_date,d.id
select id,payment_id,actor_id,actor_name,action,comment,snapshot,created_at from payment_events where payment_id=#{paymentId} order by created_at,id
